999008199.text: ふむ……ふむふむふむ
うん。なかなか良さそうね
おお。これに目を留められるとは、お目が高い

localizations.en: Oh! You have a discerning eye to notice that piece.

999008199.text:
ふふ。いい品を並べているわね。
他にも色々隠しているんでしょう？

localizations.en: Hehe. You have some fine wares on display. I imagine you're hiding even more, aren't you?

999008199.text: おや、お見通しですか。では、秘蔵の品を

localizations.en: My, you see right through me. In that case, let me show you my prized collection.

999008199.text: あら。想像以上ね……ふむ

localizations.en: Oh my. This exceeds my expectations... Interesting.

999008199.text: これ、どれくらい用意できるかしら？

localizations.en: How much of this can you procure for me?

999008199.text:
ふっ。これだけの量では不足ですかな？　
値は張りますぞ？

localizations.en: Heh. Is this quantity insufficient? I should warn you, it will be quite expensive.

999008199.text:
ふふ。買えそうにもない相手には、
存在すら悟らせないのでは？

localizations.en: Hehe. You wouldn't even hint at the existence of such items to someone who couldn't afford them, would you?

999008199.text:
仰る通り、表には出せない品ですからな。
内密にお願いしますよ？

localizations.en: Quite right. These aren't the sort of goods I can display publicly. I trust you'll keep this confidential?

999008199.text:
ええ。大切な秘密を曝け出すほど、野暮じゃないわ。
そうね、これくらい欲しいのだけど？

localizations.en: Of course. I'm not so crude as to expose someone's precious secrets. Now then, I'd like about this much, if you please?

999008199.text:
なんと！　少々特殊な伝手を使いますので、
お時間をいただきますが、よろしいですか？

localizations.en: Goodness! I'll need to utilize some rather specialized channels, so it will take some time. Is that acceptable?

999008199.text: ええ、お願いするわね。あとは、これと――

localizations.en: Yes, I'll leave it to you. I'll also take this, and—

999008199.text: 不穏だな
そうか？　ただの菓子屋に見えるが？

localizations.en: Really? Looks like an ordinary confectionery shop to me.

999008199.text: ああいう店に裏の顔がある場合もある

localizations.en: Places like that sometimes have another side to them.

999008199.text:
今でこそ比較的大人しくしているが、
奴は罪に問われた非合法組織、元極夜の錬金党の党首だ

localizations.en: She may be keeping a low profile now, but she's the former leader of the Polar Night Alchemists—an illegal organization that was charged with crimes.

999008199.text:
再び動き出した可能性は、大いにある。
考えすぎかもしれないが、王国には責任があるのだ

localizations.en: There's a strong possibility she's starting to make moves again. I may be overthinking it, but the kingdom bears responsibility here.

999008199.text:
そういうモンかね？
まあ、油断も隙もねえ相手じゃあるけどよ

localizations.en: You think so? Well, she's definitely not someone you can let your guard down around.

999008199.text: 頼むぞマクダ。私は……

localizations.en: I'm counting on you, Magda. I have to...

999008199.text:
へいへい。言われなくても、お前の言いたいことは
分かってるよ。ったく、人使いが荒い奴だぜ

localizations.en: Yeah, yeah. I know what you're gonna say without you spelling it out. Geez, you're a slave driver.

999008199.text:
（折しもリンデ祭を目前に、人々の心が浮つく時期だ。
　王国の治安のため、一層警戒せねば）

localizations.en: (With the Linde Festival approaching, people's hearts are restless. For the safety of the kingdom, I must remain vigilant.)

999008199.text:
優れた才を持つ、元「極夜の錬金党」党首の錬金術士。
街を歩いて店を回り、何やら品定めをしている

localizations.en: A talented alchemist and former leader of the Polar Night Alchemists. She's walking through town, visiting various shops and appraising their goods.

2072370017.text: クリセルダ・アメルハウザー

999008199.text:
通称「ブラッド」。ランターナ王国錬金爵。
元「極夜の錬金党」党首のクリセルダを警戒している

localizations.en: Known as Brad, he serves as the Seneschal of Alchemy for the Kingdom of Lantarna. He's keeping a close watch on Criselda, the former Polar Night Alchemist leader.

2072370017.text: ブラッドリー・カーン

999008199.text:
王都では名の知れた「喧嘩屋」。
腕が立つため、ブラッドに雇われている

localizations.en: A renowned fighter known as the Brawl Master in the capital. Her skills are so formidable that Brad has hired her services.
